name: Voucher & Coupon Management
one_liner: Issue, redeem and reconcile product vouchers and coupons with fraud controls.
fits_when: patients get copay, free-trial or discount vouchers through HCPs, a hub, field reps or self sign-up
partner pharmacies redeem vouchers at the counter against a bill
redemptions are checked by fraud rules before they count
pharmacies are settled monthly for approved redemptions
gives_you: Campaigns with benefit, cap, budget, voucher limit and maker-checker go-live
Patient enrollment with consent and voucher issue with SMS or WhatsApp delivery
Pharmacy redemption with bill upload, automatic benefit and fraud rules
A fraud review queue and monthly pharmacy settlements
A campaign 360 page and a programme dashboard

welcome.message: This is the Voucher & Coupon Management template, running on demo data. Switch roles with View as. Tell me what to change: flows, fields, screens, roles or the look. You can also build it as it is.
suggestions: Send a WhatsApp reminder before a voucher expires

catalogue.description: Run voucher and coupon programmes end to end: Program Managers set up campaigns and budgets, Support Agents enrol patients and issue codes, partner pharmacies redeem them against a bill, fraud rules flag suspicious redemptions for review, and approved redemptions are settled with each pharmacy monthly.
